name: Production Data Visualization
description: Choose, build, present, and verify accessible charts, diagrams, dashboards, maps, schedules, and interactive visual reports as durable KimiBuilt artifacts.

chain.step: Lock the analytical job, data shape, claim title, audience, caveats, and mobile reading path.
Use graph-diagram for durable SVG comparison, time, relationship, and software-structure visuals.
Use code-sandbox project mode for richer interactive, statistical, geospatial, Gantt, coordinated, or live views.
Package report, slide, PDF, spreadsheet, or Markdown figures through the document workflow when requested.
Verify source claims when data is current or external, then run desktop and mobile browser QA.
